title: Example template: quality-control a daily precipitation series
prompt: Inspect raw_precipitation.csv and produce cleaned.csv and qc_flags.csv. The intended daily axis is 2020-01-01 through 2020-03-30 inclusive. cleaned.csv must contain exactly one row for every date with columns timestamp and precipitation_mm, sorted chronologically. For duplicate timestamps retain the first occurrence in file order. Convert negative precipitation to a missing value; do not replace missing or negative observations with zero or an estimate. qc_flags.csv must contain one row per detected issue with columns timestamp and issue. Use issue values duplicate_timestamp, negative_precipitation, and missing_timestamp. Record one duplicate_timestamp flag per duplicated date, one negative_precipitation flag per affected date, and one missing_timestamp flag per absent date.
data_description: Synthetic daily precipitation in millimetres with known duplicate timestamps, negative values, and missing dates.
setup_notes: Python, NumPy, pandas, and SciPy are pre-installed.
Do not infer or fill missing precipitation values.
